programs.description: A teacher's heart is captured by a rough criminal. She believes love can transform even the most difficult soul, and sets out to prove it through their unexpected romance.
James, a Hindu orphan, is raised by Lawrence, a Catholic priest. Later, things become complicated when he falls for Julie, but Lawrence urges him to marry Diana.
Valluvanar is an honest politician. When his son Kamban is arrested, he refuses to bail him out of jail. The opposition party takes advantage of the situation and thus helps Kamban escape from jail.
Vasanth, the son of a wealthy businessman, falls in love with Priya when he visits Rajasthan. He impersonates a man named Vasanth Kumar, who had saved her life before, in order to woo her.
After losing his lover, teacher Manohar's life stagnates. His friends intervene, reigniting his passion for life and opening doors to new love.
A happy-go-lucky man falls head over heels for a girl from a wealthy family who rebuffs his sentiments. However, the man leaves no stone unturned to win her heart.
